description: Register a SlackPostResource (bot-token chat.postMessage, or an incoming-webhook URL) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Omit if using webhook_url_env_var instead.

webhook_url_env_var.label: Webhook URL Env Var
webhook_url_env_var.description: Environment variable holding a Slack incoming-webhook URL. Omit if using token_env_var instead.

name: Slack Resource
